baseline: A: frozen original policy; no value head or search
search_only: B: frozen original actor plus outcome-calibrated value head; no self-play updates
trained: C: same calibrated initialization; joint policy/value training on 2000 MCTS self-play games; report WITH and WITHOUT search

calibration.validation: episode % 5 == 0; select minimum validation MSE among epochs 0..16; fallback to zero/train outcome mean if no improvement
calibration.opponents: half stochastic frozen-policy self-play; half stochastic frozen policy vs Greedy, alternating Greedy seat

selfplay.final_selection: fixed final ep02000; never select on heldout scores
selfplay.temperature: visit sampling first 24 moves then max visits; root Dirichlet noise throughout
selfplay.adjudication: goal first, threefold exact repetition second, 160-play cap third; repetition and cap targets zero, reported separately
selfplay.symmetry: shared X/Y reflection; policy permuted, current-player value unchanged

evaluation.protocol: existing Arena paired-opening-v1; common independent openings, same pair in both seats; standard start separate control; exact deterministic cycles draws
evaluation.ci: existing 95% pair-level Hoeffding score bounds; W/D/L rate bounds on pair means; paired method contrasts with prespecified simultaneous correction
evaluation.exclusions: all historical recorded training geometry, calibration/self-play geometry and historical heldout opening books; no evaluation games enter training
evaluation.additional_greedy_diagnostics: 50 development games and 18 immediate-win probes for every checkpoint via existing diagnose_checkpoint

compute: actual games, plies, simulations, neural state evaluations, batch forwards, gradient updates, CPU wall time, CUDA event elapsed intervals; intervals not exclusive GPU kernel time
